review.why: Writes accounting, audit, FP&A, treasury and banking resumes with exact currency, basis, deal status and credential wording.
review.summary: Asks for target role, level and jurisdiction, then gives evidence prompts per track. It keeps currency, period and basis clear, separates a modeled saving from a realized one, distinguishes announced, signed and closed deals, describes controls without guaranteeing compliance and keeps credential status exact. It gives no investment or licensing advice.
strengths: Separates analysis, recommendation, plan and realized result
Credential status exact: exam passed is not licensed
Confidential matters handled with approved aggregates
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Regulated designation wording may need checking with the issuing body
